text: elaine: Quick heads-up — I'm going to start a staged move of /docs -> /docs/v2 across locales this afternoon to unblock the marketing launch. Plan is 4 PRs: 1) core EN move, 2) redirects, 3) locale folders (es/fr/*), 4) SDK snippet updates. Need reviewer assignments and a merge ordering that avoids breaking previews or linkcheck. ETA: 15:30 PT for the first PR. miguel: Sounds good. Two quick concerns: linkcheck CI is flaky right now; it tends to fail on locale anchors. Also we should coordinate merges so redirects land before locale moves to reduce 404s. sam: I can review the core EN move. Will prioritize an expedited review window. @rachel can you take redirects? rachel: I can take redirects but FYI I saw broken anchors in es/guide/quickstart.md earlier — looks like some headings changed id string after renames. Linkcheck reported missing "#setup-guide" -> the heading is now `## Quick start`. ben: SDK snippets update here — we need to regenerate language snippets after the move because paths are hardcoded in generated examples. I’ll run codegen and push the snippet PR after core move merges. docs-bot: Preview created for PR 7162: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-7162 — core-en move. Snapshot: /docs/v2/index.html ci-bot: linkcheck: FAILED in preview PR 7163 (redirects): es/guide/index.md line 42 -> anchor "#setup-guide" not found. elaine: Good catch, rachel + ci-bot. Plan update: 1) Merge core EN move (PR 7162) -> 2) Run a focused linkcheck job against merged main to collect broken anchors -> 3) Apply redirects PR (7163) referencing new v2 paths with temporary 302s -> 4) Locale move PRs (7164/7165) -> 5) SDK snippets PR (7166) last. miguel: Can we short-circuit linkcheck failures by adding a temporary HTML anchor shim for locales? Eg add at top of es/guide/index.md: ``` ``` That buys time while we fix real headings. sam: Fine with that if it's documented and removed later. Also let's gate merges to the post-12:00 UTC merge window to avoid interfering with the APAC smoke test. rachel: I'll add the shim where needed and a note in the PR description "TEMP: shim for linkcheck — remove after redirect+locale PRs merge". Also will run `yarn docs:linkcheck --paths es/* --only-anchors` locally. ben: For SDK snippets: after core merge I’ll run codegen with the new base path: ``` make gen-snippets SNIPPET_BASE=/docs/v2 ``` I’ll include a tiny test that validates snippet links are 200 in preview. docs-bot: Preview 7163 (redirects) updated: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-7163 — note: redirect rules are in /netlify/_redirects-v2. ci-bot: flaky: we saw intermittent network timeouts hitting preview host; retriggered linkcheck job 3/3 passes on PR 7162 now. elaine: OK assigning: sam -> PR 7162 (core EN), rachel -> PR 7163 (redirects + shims), miguel -> PRs 7164/7165 (locales), ben -> PR 7166 (snippets). Merge order enforced by me: 7162 then 7163 then locales then snippets. Everyone please add "Merge window: post-12:00 UTC" in PRs and ping me when green. sam: I’ll do a fast review today and leave inline comments. Expect approval by 14:45 PT. rachel: shim commits pushed to 7163, including a TODO comment linking back to this thread. Also added test note for CI. miguel: prepping locale PRs. Will split es and fr into separate PRs to reduce diff size. I’ll include a checklist in PR describing anchors to check. ben: Codegen run queued. Once 7162 is merged I’ll rebase and run tests against preview URL. I’ll add a small script `./scripts/verify-snippets.sh ` that checks snippet link status. docs-bot: Deployment note: Canary traffic will be 5% for redirects after PR 7163 merge. Rollback plan: revert redirect file and re-deploy. ci-bot: linkcheck passed for PR 7162 after retries. PR 7163 still shows one missing anchor in es/guide: I can ignore it if shim is present but we should track removing shim later. elaine: Thanks all. Final checklist before merge order: - [sam] approve 7162 by 14:45 PT - [rachel] ensure shims + redirect rules in 7163 and CI green - [miguel] split locale PRs small, include anchor checklist - [ben] gen snippets and verification script ready If anyone hits new failures, call it out here and we’ll hold merges. :thumbsup: sam: Approved 7162. Merged at 15:02 PT. docs-bot: PR 7162 merged — preview snapshot: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/snapshot/7162 ci-bot: linkcheck sweep on main triggered; collecting failures to create follow-up tasks. rachel: Redirects PR 7163 is green after shim; merging now and will watch canary. docs-bot: PR 7163 merged — redirect rules active (5% canary). miguel: Locale PR 7164 (es) opened and previewing. Ran `yarn docs:linkcheck --paths es/**` — found 3 anchor mismatches, adding fixes. ben: Rebased 7166 against main and ran `./scripts/verify-snippets.sh https://preview.redwood-inference.com/snapshot/7163` — all snippet links returned 200. Will push final commit after es merge. elaine: Solid. Let's keep this pattern for future multi-PR refactors: core -> redirects -> locales -> snippets, use temporary shims for linkcheck, and always gate merges to a merge window. Thanks everyone.
